entries.title: Proverbs 4:1
segments: ¶Hear, [my] children, the instruction of a father, And give attention to know understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 4:2
segments: For I give you good doctrine: Do not forsake my law.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:3
segments: When I was my father's son, Tender and the only one in the sight of my mother,

entries.title: Proverbs 4:4
segments: He also taught me, and said to me: "Let your heart retain my words; Keep my commands, and live.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:5
segments: Get wisdom! Get understanding! Do not forget, nor turn away from the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:6
segments: Do not forsake her, and she will preserve you; Love her, and she will keep you.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:7
segments: Wisdom [is] the principal thing; [Therefore] get wisdom. And in all your getting, get understanding.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:8
segments: Exalt her, and she will promote you; She will bring you honor, when you embrace her.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:9
segments: She will place on your head an ornament of grace; A crown of glory she will deliver to you."

entries.title: Proverbs 4:10
segments: Hear, my son, and receive my sayings, And the years of your life will be many.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:11
segments: I have taught you in the way of wisdom; I have led you in right paths.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:12
segments: When you walk, your steps will not be hindered, And when you run, you will not stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:13
segments: Take firm hold of instruction, do not let go; Keep her, for she [is] your life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:14
segments: ¶Do not enter the path of the wicked, And do not walk in the way of evil.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:15
segments: Avoid it, do not travel on it; Turn away from it and pass on.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:16
segments: For they do not sleep unless they have done evil; And their sleep is taken away unless they make [someone] fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:17
segments: For they eat the bread of wickedness, And drink the wine of violence.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:18
segments: But the path of the just [is] like the shining sun, That shines ever brighter unto the perfect day.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:19
segments: The way of the wicked [is] like darkness; They do not know what makes them stumble.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:20
segments: ¶My son, give attention to my words; Incline your ear to my sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:21
segments: Do not let them depart from your eyes; Keep them in the midst of your heart;

entries.title: Proverbs 4:22
segments: For they [are] life to those who find them, And health to all their flesh.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:23
segments: Keep your heart with all diligence, For out of it [spring] the issues of life.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:24
segments: Put away from you a deceitful mouth, And put perverse lips far from you.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:25
segments: Let your eyes look straight ahead, And your eyelids look right before you.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:26
segments: Ponder the path of your feet, And let all your ways be established.

entries.title: Proverbs 4:27
segments: Do not turn to the right or the left; Remove your foot from evil.
